verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a REST API, personal access tokens, OAuth, webhooks, a published OpenAPI spec and an open-source MCP server package, but no item mentions an official client SDK or library for any language. A raw REST API and an OpenAPI spec are developer building blocks that could be used to generate an SDK; they are not the SDK itself, so this applicable axis earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
